name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly raises EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute cost. The trade-off is added pipeline complexity—we must integrate it carefully to avoid slowing down the workflow. This is the fastest path to a measurable 0.5%+ capability bump with minimal risk.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t spatial resolution—it’s the model’s latent corruption during generation. RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler risks over-smoothing EXCAVA’s output, masking the flaw instead of solving it. The real test: run EXCAVA’s worst-case face samples through both the upscaler and a fresh RealVisXL 5.0 generation—compare the faces before and after.
